# dsh-agentmail — Agent Mail for DeepSeek Harness
English | 简体中文

A DeepSeek Harness **plugin** that lets an agent send and receive email through
the QQ **Agent Mail*

* mailbox (via `agently-cli`),
routes incoming replies **back into the DSH Session that owns the thr

ead**, and
hands mail for **unknown conversations** to a fallback Session (or ignores it).
Its setti
ngs are edited on a configuration page in the Web UI.
## What it does

- **Tools** for the agent:
- `agentmail_send` — send an email; a `session`/`thread` marker is embedd

ed in
the subject automatically.
- `agentmail_list` — list a folder (inbox/sent/trash/spam).
- `agen

tmail_read` — read one message in full; HTML bodies are rendered to
clean markdown.
- `agentmail_sea

rch` — search by keyword.
- `agentmail_reply` — reply to a message (marker preserved).
- `agentmail_

poll` — check the inbox now and route new mail.
- **Poller** — every `pollIntervalMs` it lists unrea

d inbox mail, reads each new
message, parses the marker, and delivers it into the bound DSH Session

with
`agent.followup(...)` (waking the agent). A conversation that matches no live
Session goes to t

he configured **fallback Session**; with no fallback the mail
stays in the inbox and is ignored.
- *

*Configuration page** — **Settings → Agent Mail** is a full settings page;
the same page is also the

**Configure** control on the **Plugins → Agent
Mail** row, and both edit one namespace (fallback Se

ssion, sender filter,
delivery, polling, connection). The fallback Session comes from a **searchable

list of
known sessions** (type to filter by title or id), so no id has to be copied by
hand. Edits

are staged and written on
**Save**, so no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing is needed for normal use

.
- **HTML -> markdown** — QQ/Foxmail HTML bodies are rendered down to compact
markdown (`html.js`,

turndown-based): signature/report blocks
(`data-xmail_bot_mail_report`) are removed, Foxmail's borde

r-left/`mail_quote`
shells become `>` quotes, tiny icon/tracking pixels drop out, other images
becom

e `[图片]` placeholders, tables render as pipe tables. PLAIN and MARKDOWN
bodies pass through untouche

`[图片]` placeholders, tables render as pipe tables. PLAIN and MARKDOWN
bodies pass through untouched.

- **Missing-CLI hint** — when `agently-cli` cannot be executed, every tool (and the
poller) returns

the official setup doc pointer
(`https://agent.qq.com/doc/cli-setup.md`) instead of a bare ENOENT, s

o the
agent can walk the user through installation.
## The session / thread marker
Sending mail appends this to the subject:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `s` — the conversation owner: the DSH Session id (or a stable key you pass).
- `t` — the **thread*
* (topic) the agent chose.

Replies keep the marker (mail clients keep `Re: …` in the subject), so the poller
resolves `(session

, thread)` back to the same DSH Session. A mapping table is
persisted in `state.json` so routing sur

vives restarts even if the subject is
edited or the marker only survives in the snippet.
## Requirements
1. `agently-cli` installed and authorized once:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
2. The plugin installed into a profile:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Any profile name works (`web` shown as an example); `--profile <name>`
initializes the profile on fi

rst use. If the CLI is missing, the tools
return the setup hint above.
## Packaging

The published package ships a **single self-contained bundle** (`dist/index.js`):
turndown (HTML->ma

rkdown) is inlined via esbuild at `prepublishOnly` time, so
the package has **no runtime dependencie

s**. The bundle imports the DSH host
packages (`@deepseek-ai/cordis`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`, `@deep

seek-ai/dsh-tools`)
at runtime; they are **not** declared as peerDependencies on purpose — they are

resolved from the host's own install (the registry copies are unrelated) and
declaring them crashes

npm's arborist. Sources live in `index.js` + `html.js`;
`npm run build` regenerates the bundle.
## Configuration

Open **Plugins** in the sidebar, select `@zt8989/dsh-agentmail`, and use
**Configure** on the `agent

mail` row. The page writes the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` for you; the same values can be set ther

The page writes the profile's
`cordis.patch.yml` for you; the same values can be set there by hand:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The fallback Session id is the same id the Session menu copies. Mail that reaches
the fallback is ma

rked as an unknown conversation in the delivered text, and it
does not create a thread binding: if t

hat Session later comes back, its own
threads route to it again.
## Group chats (DS Bot)

In a DS Bot **group chat**, each member Bot speaks from its own hidden group
Session, not from the g

roup's canonical Session. Sending mail from inside such a
turn would otherwise raise the marker from

that one member's Session, and replies
would land in a private thread with that single Bot.

This plugin reads DS Bot's roster (`<DSH_HOME>/bot/state.json`) read-only and, when
the sending Sess

ion belongs to a group (canonical Session, a member's group
Session, or an archived segment), puts t

he **group's canonical Session** in the
marker instead. A reply then arrives as a message in the gro

up chat: the whole
group sees it and its admin/members decide how to answer — not a one-to-one threa

ole
group sees it and its admin/members decide how to answer — not a one-to-one thread
with one Bot.
## Notes

- Send/reply use `--confirmed` so mail is not blocked on an interactive
confirmation prompt.
- Attac

hments can be sent with the CLI directly; this plugin focuses on the
session/thread routing workflow

session/thread routing workflow.
